verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents non-interactive automation paths. A Terraform/OpenTofu provider manages clusters, networking, storage and inference resources as code. A CKS API creates, lists, updates and deletes clusters, and an Inference API ships generated Go, Python and TypeScript clients. Bearer API access tokens plus downloadable kubeconfigs let kubectl run without the Cloud Console. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline guidance or examples, documented service-account or machine credentials for CI, a first-party CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
